statement: AMD reports strong customer pull for Helios tracking ahead of its initial forecasts and strong visibility, but disclosed no dollar backlog and no remaining-performance-obligation figure.
why: Committed demand is the cleanest forward indicator, and its absence in dollar terms means AMD's 2027 doubling guide rests on qualitative visibility plus one named gigawatt commitment.

impact.mechanism: Order pull ahead of forecast implies committed demand building, but without an RPO disclosure the size of that commitment cannot be verified.

evidence.excerpt: Customer pull for Helios is very strong and tracking ahead of our initial forecasts.
No dollar backlog figure and no remaining-performance-obligation (RPO) number was disclosed.

confidence.basis: Qualitative management assertion in a secondary transcript with no quantified backlog to check it against.
